blurb.en: 5 cases · a brooch, a bazaar, a conspiracy

text.en: A wax key mold — cut by someone who’s never picked a lock

pending.en: The Missing Tiffin will turn up the first thread

misread.en: Nobody cuts a mold of a lock they can already open — they cut it for someone who can’t. Those were hands with a key on them.

text.en: Rickshaw ledger page — same handwriting as the mold order

pending.en: The Rickshaw Riddle will name who paid the fare

misread.en: The hand on the ledger is the hand that *ordered* the mold, not the hand that cut it. Find the one who writes.

text.en: A debt to Sethji, due the morning after Teej

pending.en: Solve The Peacock Brooch to bank its key clue

misread.en: The slip is signed with a V. Only one name on this wall answers to it.

text.en: A seat booked on the 11:40 to Mumbai, name left blank

pending.en: The Johari Bazaar Job holds the last thread

misread.en: A blank seat on the 11:40 belongs to whoever could afford to be gone by morning. The staff were all at work the next day.

text.en: A loft ring, SG-19 — three demands, flown by a boy who cannot read them

pending.en: The Pigeon Post holds the last thread

misread.en: Bansi flew what he was handed and could not read a line of it. A courier is not an author — what those notes prove is that somebody in this house has been selling what the house knows, and it is not the boy on the roof.

dossier.en: haveli keys since 1998 · works wax and dough daily · owes Sethji too

cleared.en: Madhav cut the wax, and that is as far as it goes. A cook does not sign a pawn slip with a V or book a seat out of Jaipur.

dossier.en: danced at three of the four scenes · on stage until dawn each time

cleared.en: Leela was on a stage until dawn every one of those nights. Nobody on a stage boards the 11:40.

dossier.en: signs with a V · orders by letter · holds no key to anything
the roofs and the skylights · cannot read or write

cleared.en: Bansi cannot write his own name. He did not fill a page of a rickshaw ledger, he did not order a mold, and he did not write three demands in a hand he cannot even read back.
